## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>C++</b> (spoiler) · <code>0001-two-sum.cpp</code></summary>

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> twoSum(vector<int>& nums, int target) {
        vector<int> output;
        for(int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++)
        {
            for(int j = i+1; j < nums.size(); j++)
            {
                if(nums[i] + nums[j] == target)
                {
                    output.push_back(i);
                    output.push_back(j);
                    return output;
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }
};
```

</details>
